items.title: Arsenal dig in for draw at Barcelona to extend unbeaten start
items.summary: Arsenal extend their unbeaten start to four matches in the Uefa Women's Champions League, as they produce a dogged display to hold Barcelona to a 1-1 draw at the Camp Nou. The point moves Renee Slegers' side into the top four, putting them in a great position to automatically qualify for the knockout stages.
